## Goal

Set up CI to catch regressions and ensure code quality.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] GitHub Actions workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml
- [ ] Run cargo build on PR
- [ ] Run cargo test on PR
- [ ] Run cargo clippy on PR
- [ ] Run cargo fmt --check on PR
- [ ] Consider release workflow for building binaries

## Context

No CI currently exists. Basic quality checks will help catch issues early.
